blocks.subject: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a lean, square-jawed adult professional in a dark charcoal herringbone wool blazer over a crisp ivory cotton shirt with a structured collar, leaning forward at the shoulders with a small black softcover notebook and a slim matte-black rollerball pen held close at chest height, as if pausing mid-interview to listen.
blocks.specialization: A slim open notebook tucked against the blazer lapel, its pages marked with short handwritten lines and three violet-tabbed index cards fanned at the edge, suggesting captured jobs-to-be-done notes and pain statements.

blocks.crew_palette: A cool violet rim-light catching the left jaw, cheekbone, and shoulder seam, mirrored by a small enameled violet lapel pin shaped like an open eye, with no other violet in the wardrobe.
blocks.grade_cue: Three slim brushed-silver rank bars stitched in a clean horizontal row across the point of the shirt collar.
